name: Cochem (Germany)
description: Hanging banner divided vertically red and white, charged at the top with the city arms of Cochem (a red field with a small shield).
history: Municipal flag of Cochem; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Cochem arms — red with a small shield
